planets.name: K2-148 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-148 with a 9.76-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-148 d was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-148. Its orbit and size follow Hirano et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
